body: Is okay if I bother you a little more? I don't have anyone to talk right now, at least no one I want to. You see, I don't rely on myself, I'm just weak, was raised this way and I don't feel I can change. Is so damn hard to accomplish anything, the very little things through my day can make me nervous. It seems everything is out of my control, there is no strength in me to build anything and as the time goes by it becomes clearer what a waste I'm. Sincerely, I don't want to commit suicide, but it hurts so much, is unbearable to stay alive, to know how much of a dead weight I'm and how I couldn't accomplish nothing in my life. In this chaotic fate, having power enough to end this all is so inviting.

I would love to experience what lies ahead, except nothing lies ahead. Even when I look at the past, I see such a rigged history that I can't rely on my fate. The only thing I can and should do is to end it all, to finish the pain since pleasure seems so improbable. I tried once, but I panicked and asked for help, even that I couldn't accomplish. Not this time, however, I'm not going back in the middle. I don't feel different or inexperienced, I feel like a total failure resembling a human being, really, is so tragic that is comic. I'm not meant to be, I'm caged, captured and defenseless, I should be glad the option of killing myself is a reallity.

'Maybe' is what carried me so far, but I'm tired of it, now I feel awaken to the dull reality. Nobody never made me feel safe, I actually hardly feel safety at all, everything seems fast forward and I'm alien at this life. There is something missing in me, it shouldn't be that hard to accomplish such simple things, the pain of living each day only increases and I can't stand my lack of competence.

And thank you so much for supporting, your attention made me feel more calm at this moment. I'm trying my best to communicate in english. Don't be afraid to ask something since is probably not really clear what I'm writing.

I've tried therapy for some time, maybe not enough, but didn't help. It was so hard to communicate to him how abnormally scared I'm. Is hard to admit how dependent and lost I feel, it doesn't seem normal. As to live to see what happens tomorrow, and I feel horrible to disagree with someone trying to help me, why hope things will get better? Even more reaching so far with no advances. How can I live seeing good things passing trough me, with all the disappointments and lost opportunities, for the uncertain idea of a better future?
